links.comparator_used: Malignancy prediction model run on all images without OOD filtering
links.outcome: Performance of a separate malignancy prediction model after filtering images by SAGE out-of-distribution score thresholds
links.effect: Filtering by SAGE score thresholds improved malignancy prediction performance; no numeric values given in the abstract
links.quote: We show how filtering images based on SAGE score thresholds can improve the performance of a separate malignancy prediction model and how our approach is robust to variations in image modality and the introduction of new diagnostic classes, providing users with a powerful tool for interrogating key differences between their data and the training distribution of an ML model before clinical implementation.
